name: PufferGo | 外贸独立站AI建站专家 | AI Website Builder for Export
author: puffergo

sections.description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for PufferGo in WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New, or manually upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/puffergo.
  2. Activate PufferGo in the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the PufferGo settings page to connect your account and start building.
sections.faq:
Is PufferGo free to use?

Yes, we offer a free tier that’s enough to create a complete website. More advanced features are available with paid plans.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. We’ve eliminated all technical barriers, and top-tier AI models from both China and the US are here to assist you. If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us—we’re happy to help. Of course, if you do have technical skills, you’ll find it even smoother to use, but the difference isn’t huge.

How does it help with SEO?

We generate Tailwind HTML code that’s extremely clean and loads incredibly fast. Unlike traditional website builders (like Elementor), there’s no bloated, redundant code.

Where is the data stored?

Only your account-related data is stored on our cloud servers. All other data remains on your own server.
sections.changelog:
0.20.4

  • Page Keywords Locked In Earlier — Step 2 now sets each page’s core and long-tail keywords. Step 3 reuses them for titles, descriptions, and block placement, so pages stop competing for the same search terms.
  • Pick a Block Template or Let AI Free-Generate — When editing a block outline, you can browse eligible templates by type (with previews) or leave the template empty for full AI free generation.
  • Fewer Failed Generations on Empty Template Rules — Fixed outbound JSON turning empty template rules into [], which could fail server validation during block generation.
  • Clearer Publish Prompt — The draft publish dialog now labels Cancel as “Cancel (Not Recommended)” so you’re nudged to publish pages for visitors.

0.20.4 (中文版)

  • 页级关键词更早定稿 — Step 2 即可为每页设定核心词与长尾词，Step 3 沿用它们写标题、描述并布到区块，避免多页抢同一搜索词。
  • 可选组件模板，也可 AI 自由生成 — 编辑区块大纲时，可按类型浏览可用组件（含预览），或不指定模板交给 AI 完全自由创作。
  • 空模板规则不再导致生成失败 — 修复出站 JSON 把空的模板 rules 编成 []、触发服务端校验失败的问题。
  • 发布引导更明确 — 草稿发布弹窗将「取消」改为「取消（不推荐）」，引导优先全部发布给访客。

0.20.3

  • Site Profile Saves Reliably on Strict Hosts — Fixed a 403 Forbidden error that could block saving your Site Profile on hosting providers with strict web firewalls (e.g. Hostinger). The REST API now uses a WAF-safe request key while remaining fully compatible with existing data and AI workflows.
  • Step 4 Generation Uses the Same Fix — AI page generation in Step 4 now passes site profile data the same safe way, so large profiles no longer get blocked before reaching the server.

0.20.3 (中文版)

  • 严格主机上也能正常保存站点画像 — 修复了在 Hostinger 等启用严格 Web 防火墙的主机上保存「站点画像」时可能出现的 403 Forbidden 错误。REST 请求改用 WAF 友好的字段名，与现有数据和 AI 工作流完全兼容。
  • Step 4 生成同步修复 — 建站 Step 4 的 AI 页面生成也采用相同方式传递站点画像，大型 profile 不再在到达服务器前被拦截。

0.20.2

  • Know What to Expect From Generated Images — While your site is being built, PufferGo now explains that the photos on the page are placeholders. Our layouts do the heavy lifting; once you swap in your own product photos in the editor, the whole page looks strikingly better.
  • A Helpful Nudge Before Regenerating — Regenerating a page changes its layout and copy, but not its images. If you try to regenerate a page you’ve already built, PufferGo lets you know first — so you don’t spend another generation hoping for different photos.
  • Header Menu Polish — Fixed the highlighted category in the product dropdown turning dark on hover, keeping the menu readable as you browse.

0.20.2 (中文版)

  • 生成配图心里有底 — 建站过程中，PufferGo 会明确告诉你页面里的图片是占位示意图。真正撑起页面的是我们的排版组件，等你在编辑器里换上自己的产品实拍，整个页面会瞬间高大上。
  • 重新生成前的贴心提醒 — 重新生成只会更换排版和文案，不会更换图片。当你对已经生成好的页面再次点击生成时，PufferGo 会先提醒一句，免得你为了换图白白多生成一次。
  • 页头菜单细节优化 — 修复了产品下拉菜单中当前选中分类在鼠标悬浮时文字变黑的问题，浏览时更清晰易读。

0.20.1

  • Smoother Product Menu on More Header Styles — The flicker-free, two-column product dropdown now works on the Stacked Flyout header too, so browsing between categories stays smooth no matter which header style you’ve picked.
  • Updates Now Take Effect Reliably — Fixed an issue where some scripts and styles could stay cached after a plugin update. Improvements and fixes now appear right away, without needing to clear your browser or CDN cache by hand.

0.20.1 (中文版)

  • 更多页头样式也享受顺滑产品菜单 — 无闪烁、两栏式的产品下拉菜单现在同样支持 Stacked Flyout 页头，无论你选用哪种页头样式，在分类之间浏览都保持顺滑。
  • 更新更可靠地生效 — 修复了插件更新后部分脚本和样式可能仍被旧缓存挡住的问题。改进和修复现在会即时呈现，无需手动清理浏览器或 CDN 缓存。

0.20.0

If you sell online, your shop and product pages can optionally adopt PufferGo’s polished templates, while your inquiry-based catalog products keep working exactly as before. The two product systems coexist cleanly — no confusing mode switch to flip, everything follows what you’ve enabled.

  • Zoomable Product Images — Visitors can click a product’s main image to view it full-size in a lightbox, and images now display without awkward cropping.
  • Smoother Product Image Editing — The product editor now recommends the ideal 1600×1600 square image size and arranges thumbnails in a tidy, full-width row.
  • Paste Map Embeds Directly — You can paste a full map embed code straight into the location map field — no more digging out just the URL.
  • Smoother Product Menu — The header’s product dropdown now switches between categories without flicker or momentary blank states.

0.20.0 (中文版)

  • 产品分页更统一更清爽 — 产品列表现在与站内其他页面使用同一套精致的翻页导航，且每页都铺满整齐的网格，不再出现半空的行或莫名多出的一页。

  • 地图可直接粘贴嵌入代码 — 现在可以把整段地图嵌入代码直接粘进地图字段，无需再单独抠出网址。
  • 产品菜单更顺滑 — 顶部导航的产品下拉在切换分类时不再闪烁或短暂空白。

0.18.1

  • Homepage Setup Reminder for New Sites — Your dashboard now warns you when your site still shows the default blog feed with no proper homepage set, and points you straight to where you can fix it — so visitors always land on a real page instead of a raw list of posts.
  • Cleaner Homepage Address — Homepages created by the AI site builder now use a clean web address, avoiding odd non-English characters in the URL for a more professional link.

0.18.1 (中文版)

  • 新站首页配置提醒 — 当你的站点还停留在默认博客流、没设置真正的首页时，后台会主动提醒你，并直接带你去设置的地方——确保访客打开你的域名看到的是一个像样的首页，而不是一串原始文章列表。
  • 首页链接更干净 — AI 建站生成的首页现在使用规范的英文网址，避免链接里出现中文乱码，看起来更专业。

  • SEO 工具协同更顺畅 — 新增一个安全的只读接口，让 PufferGo 的 SEO 工具能批量读取页面元信息，关键词与内容结构的整理流程更加顺滑。

0.17.0

  • More Stable Site Publishing — Fixed an issue where clicking “Publish All” in the final step of AI Site Builder could occasionally show a blank page. Added deeper diagnostics behind the scenes so any remaining edge cases can be pinpointed and fixed faster.
  • Fixed Missing Frontend Components — Resolved a packaging issue that could cause interactive elements (like sliders or tabs) to silently fail to load on the live site.

  • 修复前台组件偶发失效 — 解决了打包遗漏导致轮播、标签页等互动组件在正式站点上偶尔加载不出来的问题。

0.16.0

  • 发布结果更真实 — 建站最后一步如果有页面发布失败，现在会明确告诉你是哪个页面、什么原因，不再笼统提示”全部完成”。

  • 新增 5 个大疆风格设计组件 — 视频大图首屏、居中导语、三种热推产品展示布局加入组件库，同时优化了证书网格排版和首屏斜角细节。

  • 主题样式隔离优化 — 按钮悬停保护改为分层防御，既隔离主题干扰，又不会误伤组件自身的悬停效果。

  • Daily Check-in Rewards — Check in once a day right from your PufferGo dashboard and earn free AI credits. Keep your streak going and watch your credits balance grow instantly — no extra steps, just one click.

  • Smoother Plugin Updates — When a newer plugin version is required, PufferGo now takes you straight to the WordPress Updates screen and refreshes the update check for you, so the latest version is always one click away.
  • Hardened Contact & Comment Forms — Added extra protection against abusive submissions, and the Coming Soon settings correctly save an emptied field instead of silently ignoring it.
  • More Reliable Blog Pagination — Page number and posts-per-page values passed to the blog archive API are now safely bounded, preventing invalid or oversized requests.

0.15.0 (中文版)

  • 联系表单与评论安全加固 — 增加了对恶意提交的防护；Coming Soon 设置里清空某个字段后也能正确保存，不会再被静默忽略。
  • 博客分页更稳健 — 博客归档接口的页码和每页条数参数现在会做安全边界校验，避免异常或超大请求。

0.14.0

  • Product Panel Redesign — The product showcase panel has been completely restructured with improved information architecture, making it easier to organize and display your product information on landing pages.
  • Sticky Toolbar — The top toolbar now stays fixed when you scroll, keeping all editing tools constantly within reach.
  • Enhanced Element Tree Navigation — The structure tree now uses a four-level visual hierarchy to better distinguish between different element types, plus you can now directly edit text within mixed image-text blocks without extra clicks.

0.14.0 (中文版)

  • 商品面板全新设计 — 商品展示面板经过重构，信息架构更清晰，让你在落地页上更轻松地组织和展示产品信息。
  • 顶部工具栏吸顶 — 编辑工具栏现在固定在屏幕顶部，滚动页面时始终可见，编辑工具随时可用。
  • 结构树导航体验升级 — 结构树现在采用四层视觉分层来区分不同元素类型，更清晰易懂；图文混合的块内也支持直接编辑文本，减少多余操作。

0.13.3

  • Color-Coded Page Structure Tree — The structure tree in the edit panel now highlights what matters: images, videos, links, and buttons stand out in bold indigo chips with type icons, headings show in green, editable text in blue, and layout containers fade into the background — so you can instantly spot the elements worth configuring.
  • Breadcrumb Navigation for Selected Elements — A new breadcrumb trail at the top of the tree shows exactly where the selected element sits in the page, and clicking any step jumps straight to that parent — no more hunting up through nested containers.
  • Always Know Where You Are — Selecting an element on the page now scrolls the tree so the selection sits centered in view with a brief highlight flash, its parents expand automatically, and the tree no longer scrolls sideways, so the selected row is always fully visible.
  • Smoother Tree Behavior — The first level is expanded by default, branches you collapse stay collapsed while you edit, and editing content no longer makes the tree jump away from where you scrolled.

0.13.3 (中文版)

  • 页面结构树分级配色 — 编辑面板的结构树现在按重要程度着色：图片、视频、链接、按钮用醒目的靛紫色块加类型图标，标题为绿色，可编辑文本为蓝色，布局容器则淡化为灰色——需要配置的元素一眼就能找到。
  • 选中元素的面包屑导航 — 结构树顶部新增面包屑路径，清楚展示当前选中元素在页面中的位置，点击任意一级即可直接跳到对应的父级容器，不用再一层层往上翻。
  • 选中位置一目了然 — 在页面上选中元素后，结构树会自动展开父级并将选中行滚动到视野正中，配合高亮闪烁提示；树不再左右滚动，选中行始终完整可见。
  • 结构树操作更顺手 — 默认展开第一层结构；你手动折叠的分支在编辑过程中会保持折叠；编辑内容时树也不会再自己跳走，停留在你正在查看的位置。

0.13.2

  • Automatic Alt Text for Gallery Images — Logos, testimonial photos, and other images in carousel/marquee-style blocks now carry their own ALT text field, so search engines and screen readers get meaningful descriptions instead of blank or generic text — better for SEO and accessibility.
  • Smarter Image Selection — When you pick an image from the media library for a block, its ALT text and title are now automatically filled in from the library (only if you haven’t already set your own), and you’ll get a heads-up if an image is still missing ALT text. Previously saved images also now show their real file name instead of a generated guess.

0.13.2 (中文版)

  • 图册类图片自动带上 ALT 文本 — 轮播、跑马灯等区块里的 Logo、客户头像等图片现在都自带独立的 ALT 文本字段，搜索引擎和屏幕阅读器能读到有意义的描述，而不是空白或笼统的文字，对 SEO 和无障碍访问更友好。
  • 更智能的选图体验 — 在区块中从媒体库选图时，会自动带入该图片在媒体库中的 ALT 文本和标题（仅在你还没手动填写时生效），如果图片仍缺少 ALT 文本还会提醒你补充；已保存到媒体库的图片现在会显示真实文件名，而不是系统猜测的名字。

0.13.1

  • Improved AI Usage Insights — AI generation requests across the site builder, editor, chat, and image tools now carry a scene tag behind the scenes, giving our team clearer visibility into how each AI feature is used so we can prioritize improvements and troubleshoot issues faster.

0.13.1 (中文版)

  • AI 使用场景标识优化 — 站点搭建、编辑器、聊天、图片工具等各类 AI 生成请求现在会在后台附带场景标识，帮助我们更清晰地了解各项 AI 功能的实际使用情况，从而更精准地优化产品和排查问题。

  • 博客、案例、团队归档模板 — 谷歌会优先收录内容体系完整的外贸独立站。PufferGo 现已内置博客列表、案例研究、解决方案、客户评价和团队成员的专属列表与详情页模板，一套完整的 B2B 内容架构帮你提升 Google 排名。AI 建站自动填充内容，一次配置长期受益。
  • SEO 友好渲染，更容易被谷歌完整收录 — 重构页面渲染引擎，AI 生成的每个区块在页面加载时直接输出完整 HTML，不再依赖 JavaScript 动态渲染。你的产品描述、公司介绍和服务页面更容易被谷歌完整抓取和收录——对于做 Google SEO 的外贸独立站来说至关重要。无需额外配置 SEO 插件。
  • AI 建站提速，自动生成 SEO 元信息 — AI 建站改为多页并发执行，整站生成速度大幅提升。规划阶段 AI 会根据你的企业信息和目标市场，自动为每个页面生成 SEO 优化标题和 meta 描述，省去外贸人手动填写的大量时间。每个页面都针对海外 B2B 买家的搜索习惯进行优化。
  • 内置 Coming Soon 页，上线前也留下专业印象 — 用内置的维护中页面在正式上线前撑场面：完整品牌样式、移动端适配、与整站设计系统保持一致。AI 正在构建你的外贸独立站时，提前到访的海外买家看到的是专业的占位页，而不是空白屏幕。准备好了一键关闭，立即切换到正式站。

0.9.63

  • AI Site Builder — Existing Pages Protected — When running AI site building, if a homepage or blog page is already set in WordPress, PufferGo now detects and skips them instead of overwriting your settings. Menu updates are also incremental — only managed items are touched. The AI workflow default language has been changed to English for broader accessibility.
  • AI 建站保护已有页面设置 — 运行 AI 建站时，如果 WordPress 已设置了首页或博客页，PufferGo 会检测并跳过覆盖，保留你原有的配置。菜单更新改为增量模式，仅修改已管理的项目。AI 建站默认语言调整为 English，更好地服务多语言用户。

0.9.62

  • Customizable Product Archive URL — You can now set your own URL prefix for product listing pages (Settings > Permalinks > “Product archive base”). This avoids potential URL conflicts with WooCommerce and gives you full control over your product page structure.
  • 产品归档地址可自定义 — 现在可以自由设置产品列表页的 URL 前缀（设置 > 固定链接 > “Product archive base”），避免与 WooCommerce 产生链接冲突，让产品页地址完全按照你的意愿来。

0.9.61

  • Easier Product Category Management — Product categories now appear by default in Appearance → Menus, so you can add them to your website navigation without any extra setup.
  • Clearer Category Labels — Product category name updated to “PufferGo Categories” to avoid confusion with WooCommerce categories, making it more intuitive to use.
  • Smarter AI Site Building — Fixed an issue where running AI site building multiple times could create duplicate pages, ensuring your site stays clean and organized.
  • More Reliable Display — Resolved a conflict between custom color names and built-in system styles, ensuring your website displays correctly every time.

0.9.61 (中文版)

  • 产品目录，菜单添加更方便 — 现在”外观 → 菜单”中默认显示产品分类，无需额外设置即可直接将产品分类添加到网站导航中。
  • 产品名称区分更清晰 — 产品分类名称优化为”PufferGo 产品分类”，避免与 WooCommerce 分类混淆，操作更直观。
  • AI 建站更智能 — 优化了 AI 建站逻辑，多次运行不会再产生重复页面，避免网站出现多个博客页的异常情况。
  • 底层体验优化 — 修复了自定义颜色名称与系统内置样式冲突的问题，网站显示更加稳定可靠。

0.9.60

  • Smoother Code Editing — Significantly improved the HTML source code editor experience. Typing is now smooth and responsive, with no more browser freezes.
  • Complete Code After Refresh — Fixed an issue where the source code would appear truncated after page refresh. Full HTML is now displayed correctly every time.

  • More Stable Editor — Under-the-hood improvements for better overall stability and compatibility of the editing experience.

  • 编辑源码不再卡顿 — 大幅优化了”编辑源码”弹窗的编辑体验，打字流畅不卡顿，告别浏览器卡死的问题。

  • 刷新后源码显示完整 — 修复了页面刷新后源码内容被截断的问题，现在每次打开都能看到完整的 HTML 代码。
  • 编辑更稳定 — …

short_description: AI website builder built for export. Quickly create high-converting B2B brand sites optimized for Google SEO.
description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
